verdict.rationale: Azure CLI is Microsoft's official, cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources, either interactively or through scripts. It installs on Windows, Linux, macOS (via Homebrew), Docker and Cloud Shell, and offers tab completion and JMESPath `--query` output shaping, which suits automated and agent workflows. A community user independently confirms that almost everything can be done via the command line. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of AI- or agent-oriented CLI features such as documented non-interactive or agent auth flows or machine-readable output guidance aimed at agents.
